string-array.name: widget_quotes
string-array.item: Time is what we want most, but what we use worst.|William Penn
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.|Seneca
We are what we repeatedly do.|Will Durant
Life is what happens to you while you\'re busy making other plans.|John Lennon
Lose an hour in the morning, and you will spend all day looking for it.|Richard Whately
Until you value yourself, you won\'t value your time.|M. Scott Peck
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.|Annie Dillard
Concentration is the root of all the higher abilities in man.|Bruce Lee
Don\'t count the days, make the days count.|Muhammad Ali
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.|Chinese proverb
Make each day your masterpiece.|John Wooden
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.|Lao Tzu

string-array.name: widget_messages
string-array.item: Every minute you don\'t give to the screen becomes yours again.
You don\'t need a perfect day: one good decision right now is enough.
Your attention is the most valuable thing you have. Choose wisely where it goes.
Time away from your phone is progress too.
Today counts. Do something your future self will thank you for.
What matters rarely arrives as a notification.
Breathe, look around you and come back to what really matters.
Small habits, repeated every day, change a whole life.
Unplugging for a moment is the fastest way to recharge.
Your time isn\'t endless, and that\'s exactly what makes it valuable.
Pick one important thing for today and give it your full attention.
Being kind to yourself when you slip up is part of progress too.
